verification_method: Launched the committed v1.2.0 package with its isolated .venv, ran all source/data and Streamlit AppTest contracts, then visited every persona with a headless Microsoft Edge browser and refreshed the three current screenshots.
fresh_dependency_install_note: The earlier clean-copy v1.1 verification remains the installation-portability test because requirements and launchers did not change. This record verifies the v1.2 UI/data contracts and rendered browser state, not a second dependency installation.
boundary: This verifies v1.2 deterministic data contracts, Streamlit interactions, and rendered role/contrast behavior. It is not an independent human usability study or validation of the underlying evaluation metrics.
